This notebook reports saved results only. It cannot fit models. For independent
machine execution use `study2-eivGP.R` and `study2-competitors.R`; see
[Study II reproduction](study2-README.md). The historical view uses the audited
merged core export once; the two lanes read their own complete paper workload.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=TRUE)
if(params$action!="report")stop("This notebook is report-only")
here<-dirname(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE))
repo<-normalizePath(file.path(here,"../.."))
root<-if(nzchar(params$results_root))params$results_root else Sys.getenv("EIVGP_RESULTS_ROOT")
if(!nzchar(root))stop("Set results_root or EIVGP_RESULTS_ROOT")
if(params$lane=="historical") {
  source(file.path(here,"study2.R"),local=TRUE)
  result<-study2_analysis(root,tables_dir=if(nzchar(params$tables_dir))params$tables_dir else NULL)
} else {
  source(file.path(here,"common.R"),local=TRUE)
  numerical_package_check()
  source(file.path(here,"study2-common.R"),local=TRUE)
  controls<-modifyList(list(output=root,action="report"),params$options)
  if(!identical(controls$action,"report"))stop("options cannot enable fitting")
  result<-study2_paper_workflow(params$lane,controls,repo)
}
```

## Comparative evidence

Original categorical predictors use all responses and ignore calibration.
Complete-case adaptations receive the same exact inputs as EIV-GP but fit fewer
responses. FULL is EIV-GP; CUT is the secondary feedback ablation. Missing jobs
remain missing. Replication MCSEs omit within-fit error, and diagnostic warnings
are retained. Independent machine outputs must be paired by dataset and method,
not compared by averaging host-level summaries.

```{r results, results='asis'}
if(params$lane=="historical") {
  cat("Historical core export; follow-up results are reported separately. This is not a merged final-paper report.\n\n")
  if(!nrow(result$diagnostics))cat("No diagnostic table was supplied with this selected export.\n\n")
  cat("Source:",result$source,"\n\n")
  print(eivGP::report_table(result$summary,caption="Saved paper scores and replication MCSEs"))
  print(eivGP::report_table(eivGP::summarize_diagnostics(result$diagnostics)))
} else print(result)
```

packageVersion("eivGP")
sessionInfo()
